# FMC Media PC 0.3.19

- Timeline previews for streams: hover the timeline to see the picture at that moment, with the time and chapter underneath. Streams get their picture on demand from a hidden, low-priority copy of the player, only for where the pointer stops; local files still get all previews made ahead. Torrents are left out so previews never take speed from playback.
- MediaInfo in playback diagnostics: container, overall bitrate and the encoder; video format with profile and level, HDR format (Dolby Vision profile, HDR10+, HDR10), bit depth, colour and mastering data; every audio track's full format name (for example Dolby Digital Plus with Dolby Atmos), channels and bitrate; and every subtitle track. It reads only the start and end of a file or stream. MediaInfo 26.10 by MediaArea is included (BSD-2-Clause).

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
